eidolonunchained.codex.entry.shadow_comm: A field guide to the first dark rite in the rebuilt Nyxathel datapack.

Shadow Communion is the foundational rite of Nyxathel's path. It is not a plea shouted into darkness, but a deliberate opening made through repeating Wicked signs and sealing the invocation with Blood.

This rebuilt datapack uses Shadow Communion as the anchor example for dark-deity support. The chant creates a spell, the ritual loader registers an AI rite, the research entry tracks discovery, and the fate system can assign a matching task to followers of Nyxathel.

Draw two Wicked signs and close with Blood. This sequence is intentionally minimal: it demonstrates deity-linked chant casting, sign effects, codex integration, and AI conversation routing without depending on archived content.

Those who carry an unholy symbol into the Deep Dark and complete the rite advance the Shadow Communion Study, proving how codex, research, ritual, and fate content can reinforce a single deity coherently.
